detail.longDescription: Your AI assistant is good at reading an inbox. It can summarize a long thread, draft a reply, and flag what needs your attention. Then you close the tab, and Gmail goes back to being a pile. The invoice is still sitting in an attachment, the new lead is still waiting on an answer, and nobody has turned that "can you send me the deck?" email into a task. You can change that without leaving the AI tool you already use. Install Zapier in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor, describe what should happen when
